reasoning: This is an OS status-bar indicator (specifically Android's cellular signal triangle with a warning exclamation mark), representing a system state rather than a concrete object or activity. Outside a device status bar it looks like an abstract triangle with an exclamation mark, and tasks about fixing phone reception are better served by a phone or antenna icon.
